title: Introducing Minecraft's loaded Wind Charge Orbital Strike Cannon
description:
In the last few days I made this Cannon.
It's currently in it's early stages but im trying to keep improving 
this Cannon design.
I don't think this Cannon is better than the original Orbital Strike Cannon.

It is designed for uses in which a normal OSC wouldnt work.

The Cannons biggest advantages are the ability to build it on paper server and to build it in chunk-loaded areas.
It's also pretty easy to use.
The reason why Id call it an Orbital Strike Cannon is because it uses the same powdered snow mechanic to stop the payload.

In the  next version of the cannon I will Improve the Payload to hopefully
make the cannon able to fire stab shots.


If yal lwant the schematic comment and ill make a video in which i explain how it works and how tu use it...
